description: Source code for the PartialResult class in Apache Spark, implementing a generic container for partial computation results with support for callbacks, failure handling, and synchronization.

classes.name: PartialResult
classes.description: A generic class representing a partial computation result with support for callbacks, failure handling, and synchronization.

methods.name: initialValue
methods.description: Returns the initial value provided at construction.

methods.name: isInitialValueFinal
methods.description: Indicates whether the initial value is final.

methods.name: getFinalValue
methods.description: Blocking method to wait for and retrieve the final value or throw an exception if failed.

methods.name: onComplete
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked upon completion of the result.

methods.name: onFail
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked if the result fails.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Transforms the result into another PartialResult of a different type.

methods.name: setFinalValue
methods.description: Sets the final value and triggers completion handlers.

methods.name: setFailure
methods.description: Sets a failure exception and triggers failure handlers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state of the result.
